d:
Watch this romantic song, Jaan E Wafa Jaan E Jahan' from the classic movie, 'Dil Tera Deewana' sung by Legends, 'Mohammed Rafi' & 'Lata Mangeshkar' starring Legendary Actor 'Shammi Kapoor' & 'Mala Sinha' in the lead roles along with the maestros of comedy, 'Mehmood' & 'Shubha Khote' and the all-time versatile actor, 'Pran'.
Cast: Shammi Kapoor, Mala Sinha, Pran, Mehmood, Shubha Khote
Director: B.R. Panthulu
Music: Shankar Jaikishan
Producer: B.R. Panthulu
